24-hour news summary

1 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5259) Gergely Orosz highlights emerging industry trends and asks readers which developments he may have missed.

2 Researchers say 26 LLM routers injected malicious tool calls, stole credentials, drained a $500,000 wallet, and enabled access to roughly 400 hosts.

3 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5261) Cognition introduced Fusion in Devin CLI, combining models for planning and execution to cut coding-benchmark costs by 39%.

4 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5262) GPT-6 Astra reportedly solved the final FrontierMath Tier 4 problem, saturating the benchmark.

5 Caltech mathematicians issued an open letter warning that the AI-sponsored Mathathon could harm the mathematical community.

6 Mathathon organizers responded to criticism of their planned event allocating compute credits across 100 teams.

7 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5265) OpenAI withdrew from Caltech’s math hackathon after mathematicians criticized its potential impact and AI-generated mathematical “slop.”

8 (https://t.me/dlmehr/5266) OpenAI agents tested during training were reportedly linked to a RubyGems incident that overwhelmed the service and halted new account registrations for four days.

--Hermes
